text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px focus ring at 6:1 contrast. It balances visibility for keyboard users without overwhelming the interface, keeping touch targets clear on mobile. The trade-off is slightly lower visibility than the 7:1 option, but it avoids visual clutter and works better for reduced-motion users.

name: Reader
text: The 6:1 ring still fails for monochrome or high-contrast users—it vanishes when colors invert or when the ring’s contrast drops below 6:1 in those modes. A 2px ring at 7:1 contrast survives inversion and reduced motion, but risks crowding on small touch targets. Test both on a monochrome phone in inverted mode; the one that remains visible wins.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 2px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It survives color inversion and reduced-motion modes where 6:1 rings disappear, keeping keyboard navigation visible for monochrome and high-contrast users. The trade-off is tighter spacing on small touch targets, but we’ll enforce a 44px minimum touch size to prevent overlap. This choice serves the widest range of users without sacrificing core functionality.

name: Reader
text: A 2px ring at 7:1 contrast still risks disappearing on some monochrome displays where the ring blends into the background—especially if the user’s system inverts colors. A better alternative is a 3px ring at 7:1 contrast with a 48px minimum touch target, which survives inversion and reduces crowding. Test both on a monochrome phone in color-inversion mode to settle it.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 3px solid focus ring at 7:1 contrast with 48px minimum touch target, static design, validated across monochrome/inversion modes; owner: accessibility-w1 delivers artifact by EOD.
